A03 · TEACHER TRIAL AND MODERATION

Test the workload.
Agree the evidence.

A practical pack for trialling the complete Year 11 and Year 12 Pygame projects and independently moderating their marking.

Download the trial packRead the protocolRead the desk review
Pack ready; real trial and independent moderation pending. No actual timing, student scores or reviewer approvals have been supplied. Candidate anchors are proposed interpretations of the existing 100 marks; the current common guide remains authoritative until the school adopts an agreed version before issue.

What is ready

The desk review identifies ambiguous partial credit, mixed year-level wording, acceptance-test gaps and constrained build time. Each year has a proposed 100-point interpretation preserving every parent item/category total and the existing task weight. Primitive shapes and all five themes retain the same maximum.

The synthetic calibration cases help teachers discuss difficult boundaries. They are invented snippets, not student work, actual trial results or a second teacher’s moderation.

Run the trial in six steps

  1. Freeze conditions: record the contract/guide/build, actual period length, nominated PC, allowed help and baseline readiness.
  2. Attempt a complete core per year: record a teacher dry run separately from prepared learner attempts. Include documentation, testing and evaluation.
  3. Observe each scheduled workshop: use the exact 10/12 slots; record support, losses, unfinished requirements and extra work explicitly.
  4. Double-mark frozen evidence independently: compare each discrepancy and agree a rationale; do not average conflicting marks.
  5. Compare all five themes: inspect labels and primitive fallbacks against the same rules; record what actually ran.
  6. Decide ready / revise and re-trial / hold: record actual teacher decisions and apply any revision equally before issue.

Available time is a ceiling

These figures are timetable arithmetic, not measured learner completion times. Setup, support and documentation use this same time. Preparation remains outside the fixed assessed workshops.

Before closing A03

Record a dated full-core trial per year, actual FR/NFR outcomes, observed time/support, all-theme checks and a second teacher’s review of the scope and marking. Resolve changes and re-trial before formal issue. A downloadable pack or passing package tests does not establish those outcomes.
